proposed.explanation: Carlos Barretto (Drexel University, graduated 1908) is historically significant as the FIRST pensionado architect to complete an American architecture degree. This predates Tomas Mapua (Cornell, 1911), Juan Arellano (Penn Academy/Drexel, 1911), and Antonio Toledo (Ohio State, 1911). Barretto's career: (1) Second registered architect in the Philippines (after Mapua); (2) Pioneered the Division of Architecture at the Bureau of Public Works; (3) Organized the Philippine Institute of Architects after WWII; (4) Designed Art Deco Carnival infrastructures for the 1935 Philippine Carnival.
